visitor details

2. Could I confirm which company you're visiting?
3. May I have the name of the person you're here to see?

Repair unclear 
communication 
1. I'm sorry, I didn't catch the company name. Could you say it again a little more slowly?

2. Would you mind waiting in the reception area while I check?

Explain a limitation + 
offer an action 
1. I'm afraid I'm unable to grant access until the visit has been confirmed.
2. What I can do is contact the office and let them know you've arrived.

Structure 
Example + note 
Indirect questions 
May I ask who you are visiting? 
 (No question-word inversion after "May I ask...".)

The appointment hasn't been confirmed yet.  Useful for an unfinished current situation.

Once I have confirmation, I can direct you to the correct lift.

I'm afraid I'm unable to...  State the restriction, then offer what you can do.

FULL SITUATIONAL DIALOGUE 2 
Unannounced Visitor Under Time Pressure 
情境二:未有預約、訪客催促 
Situation: The visitor says the matter is urgent but has no appointment. The officer must stay calm, explain 
the access restriction, protect confidentiality and offer a realistic alternative. 
Visitor 
Hi. I need to see Raymond Cheung at Sterling Asset Management. It's urgent. 
Security Officer 
Good afternoon. I understand it's urgent. 
May I ask whether Mr Cheung is expecting you today? 
Visitor 
No, but he knows who I am. I only need five minutes. 
Security Officer 
I see. May I have your name and company so I can contact his office? 
Visitor 
Elaine Foster, Westfield Advisory. Can I just go up? I'm already late. 
Security Officer 
I'm afraid I'm unable to grant access until the office confirms the visit. 
What I can do is call them now and let them know you're waiting. 
Visitor 
How long is that going to take? 
Security Officer 
It usually only takes a few minutes, 
but I don't want to promise a time before I reach them.  
Would you mind waiting by the Customer Services Counter? 
Visitor 
Fine, but please tell them it's confidential. 
Security Officer 
Certainly. I'll only say that you've arrived and would like to speak with Mr Cheung. 
I won't discuss the nature of your visit. 
Visitor 
Thank you. 
Security Officer 
You're welcome. I'll update you as soon as I hear back. 
Note on language: 
Waiting in the reception area           |              Wait by the Customer Services Counter 
 
Why this response works  為甚麼有效 
• Acknowledges the visitor's urgency without agreeing to bypass the procedure. 
• Explains the restriction calmly and gives a practical alternative. 
• Avoids making a time promise that the officer cannot guarantee. 
• Protects confidential information while still contacting the tenant.

Contradictory Floor Information 
情境三:樓層資料不一致,需要核實 
Situation: A visitor has come for a meeting, but the floor number in the visitor’s email does not match 
the building directory. 
Listen for the contradiction, confirm the important details, avoid guessing, and explain that you need to 
verify the correct location before allowing the visitor to proceed. 
Security Officer 
Good afternoon. Welcome to Three Garden Road. How may I assist you today? 
Visitor 
Hi. I’m here to see Anthony Lau at Apex Consulting. 
Security Officer 
Certainly. May I have your name, please? 
Visitor 
Sophia Flora. I have a meeting with Mr Lau this afternoon. 
Security Officer 
Thank you, Ms Flora. Could I confirm the floor with you? 
Visitor 
It says the 14th floor. 
Security Officer 
I see. There seems to be a discrepancy. 
Our building directory currently lists Apex Consulting on the 24th floor, 
rather than the 14th. 
Visitor 
Really? Are you sure the directory is up to date? 
Security Officer 
That’s a good question. 
Let me contact Apex Consulting and confirm their current location. 
Visitor 
But my email definitely says the 14th floor. 
Security Officer 
I understand your concern. 
Just to confirm, you’re here to see Mr Anthony Lau at Apex Consulting, 
and your email states the 14th floor. Is that correct? 
Visitor 
Yes, that’s correct. 
Security Officer 
Thank you. Please allow me a moment to check with their office.
Would you mind waiting in the reception area while I verify the floor? 
Visitor 
Sure. How long will it take? 
Security Officer 
It should only take a few minutes, but I’ll update you as soon as I receive 
confirmation. 
Visitor 
All right. Thank you. 
Security Officer 
You’re welcome, Ms Martin. Thank you for your patience.

Situation Card 5 — An Extra Visitor Is Not on the Appointment  情境卡五 
Student A — Security Officer 
Student B — Visitor 
• Open professionally. 
• Listen carefully and identify the problem. 
• Confirm who the appointment is with. 
• Ask for the second visitor’s details. 
• Do not assume that both visitors can go upstairs. 
• Explain politely that you need to verify the additional visitor 
with the office. 
• Ask them to wait while you check. 
• Give an update and explain the next step. 
Hidden details: 
Name: Peter Wong 
Company: Star Trading Ltd. 
Host: Ms Karen Lee, Prime Finance 
Time: 11:00 a.m. 
Floor: 16th floor

 LESSON 4 | TELEPHONE ENGLISH, MESSAGE TAKING & CONFIRMATION CALLS


Lesson 4 Communication Roadmap
第四課：電話英語、訊息記錄及確認聯絡




     OPEN 開場               IDENTIFY 核實            CLARIFY 問清楚          HOLD 等候               TRANSFER 轉駁              MESSAGE 留言                     CLOSE 結束


                        Phone Call English                                                        WhatsApp English
 More spoken and immediate. (較口語化，需要即時回應。)                           More written and concise. (較書面化，通常較精簡。)

 Use opening phrases clearly (要清楚開場及表明身份。):                          Identify yourself in the first message: (第一個訊息先表明身份。)
 “Good morning, Three Garden Road CS counter.                        ​
 How may I help you?”                                                “Good morning. This is the Three Garden Road CS counter.”

 Ask who is calling (詢問來電者身份。):                                      Confirm the recipient / situation directly (直接確認對方及事項。):
 “May I ask who’s calling, please?”                                  “May I confirm whether you are expecting Mr Lee?”

 Use hold language (需要對方在線等候時使用 hold。):                              No need to say “hold.” (WhatsApp 不需叫對方在線等候，可說稍後回覆。)
 “Please hold for a moment while I check.”                           Use: “Let me check and I’ll get back to you shortly.”

 Acknowledge after returning (重新接聽時感謝對方等候。):                         Acknowledge the message (確認已收到訊息或資料。):
 “Thank you for holding.”                                            “Thank you for confirming.” / “Thank you for the details.”

 Transfer language is important (電話可轉駁至租戶辦公室。):                      No transfer language. (WhatsApp 不會「轉駁」，而是代為聯絡及回覆。)
 “Please hold while I put you through to the tenant’s office.”       Instead: “I’ll contact the tenant / Facilities team and update you here.”

 Take a verbal message (可請對方留言或留下回電號碼。):                             The message itself becomes a written record. Ask only for missing details.
 “Would you like to leave a message or a callback number?”           (訊息本身已有文字紀錄，只需補問欠缺資料。)

 Repeat details aloud (口頭覆述資料以核對。)                                   Read back in writing (以文字覆述下一步。):
 : “Let me repeat that back to you.”                                 “Just to confirm, you would like the visitor to remain at the CS counter.”

 Use fillers to avoid silence (避免電話中長時間沉默。)                          Short gaps are normal. Messages can be sent in clear chunks.
 “One moment, please.” / “Let me check that for you.”                (文字訊息之間有短暫空檔很正常。)

 Close the call clearly (要有明確電話結尾。):                                 Close with the next action (以「下一步」作結，通常較實用。):
 “Thank you for calling. Have a good day.”                           “We’ll proceed accordingly.” / “I’ll update you here once I receive a response.”

Take a verbal message (可請對方留言或留下回電號碼。): The message itself becomes a written record. Ask only for missing details. “Would you like to leave a message or a callback number?” (訊息本身已有文字紀錄，只需補問欠缺資料。)

Repeat details aloud (口頭覆述資料以核對。) Read back in writing (以文字覆述下一步。): : “Let me repeat that back to you.” “Just to confirm, you would like the visitor to remain at the CS counter.”

Use fillers to avoid silence (避免電話中長時間沉默。) Short gaps are normal. Messages can be sent in clear chunks. “One moment, please.” / “Let me check that for you.” (文字訊息之間有短暫空檔很正常。)

Close the call clearly (要有明確電話結尾。): Close with the next action (以「下一步」作結，通常較實用。): “Thank you for calling. Have a good day.” “We’ll proceed accordingly.” / “I’ll update you here once I receive a response.”
